topic.title: Support and Resistance Are Zones, Not Magic Lines

research.summary: Markets often react around areas rather than one exact price. Repeated reactions can help you mark a zone, but the zone is not a guaranteed floor or ceiling. Watch how price behaves when it returns, consider the higher timeframe, and decide what would invalidate your idea.
